datasets.title: NEAR Intents swap volume per day (USD)
datasets.source: Intents Explorer API (ingested into ClickHouse nearesis_live.intents_swaps)
datasets.definition: Sum of amount_in_usd over swaps with status SUCCESS, by created_day (UTC), NULL USD amounts excluded; same definition as the frozen v3 research snapshot (a day with a SUCCESS swap whose USD is NULL would be null, none are in this window).
caveats: Volume counts SUCCESS swaps only. REFUNDED and FAILED swaps are excluded, which also excludes the four refunded swaps whose provider USD values are absurd (quarantined in usd-quarantine.ts).
Values are sums computed as Float64 by the research definition (toFloat64); each is printed as the shortest round-trip decimal and is exact only as printed, not as an exact decimal sum.
amount_in_usd is the provider's USD value of the input amount at swap time, not an audited price.

1Click swaps are not all NEAR Intents activity, and the Explorer shows only swaps it exposes; after 2026-10-27 private (shielded) settlement is not observed, so lower later values mean unobserved, not zero.

coverage.note: All 191 days of the window are present.

datasets.title: Daily active accounts (distinct signers)
datasets.source: BigQuery public dataset crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions (ingested into ClickHouse nearesis_live.account_daily_activity)
datasets.definition: value = COUNT(DISTINCT signer_account_id) over the day's transactions; signers_organic = the same after excluding transactions addressed to the Intents verifier and bridge contracts (documented rule in account-sql.ts).
caveats: Distinct signers are a proxy for active accounts, not people, and are not summable across days (an account active on two days counts twice).

datasets.title: Contract usage per day (function calls and active contracts)
datasets.source: BigQuery public dataset crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions (ingested into ClickHouse nearesis_live.contract_interactions and the near_daily_usage view)
datasets.definition: value = FUNCTION_CALL actions per day; active_contracts = distinct receiver accounts of those actions. Receivers with >= 100 calls that day are held individually; the rest are folded into an exact per-day remainder, so both daily totals are exact.
caveats: contract_interactions only holds receivers with >= 100 calls on a day; the per-receiver detail (and contract_usage_top) therefore omits the long tail, while the daily totals include it.
The BigQuery source queries (sql/bigquery) count transactions by receiver_account_id, a cheaper and different measure than function-call actions; the comparison is reported but is not like-for-like.

datasets.title: Top 50 receiver contracts over the window (function calls)
datasets.source: BigQuery public dataset crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions (ingested into ClickHouse nearesis_live.contract_interactions)
datasets.definition: Receivers ranked by FUNCTION_CALL actions summed over the window, counting only the days a receiver had >= 100 calls; days_listed is the number of such days.
caveats: Only receiver-days with >= 100 calls are held, so totals understate receivers that were active below the threshold on some days.
A ranking over the whole window has no per-day axis (no date column, no missing days).

datasets.title: NEAR price per day (USD)
datasets.source: Price provider (CoinGecko free plan, ingested into ClickHouse nearesis_live.price_candles)
datasets.definition: The provider's last price sample of the UTC day (close_raw as received, exact string). The free plan has no daily OHLC history, so the day's candle is built from 24 hourly samples (basis hourly_samples_24_per_day).
caveats: The 'close' is the last hourly sample of the day, not an official daily close; the frozen research used the same value converted with toFloat64.
Price is an aggregated provider quote, not a trade-weighted VWAP.

coverage.note: All 191 days of the window are present.
